name: Ember Blast 34341 hits within 8 yards, not the whole room (COA-6777)
contract: Ember Blast 34341 (Al'ar and Kael'thas's Phoenix) and its Heroic 351392 and Mythic 351393 copies get back the stock 8 yard area around the caster. A player 30 yards away takes no damage; a player beside the caster still does.
